description: Prepare a teaching workspace for an async JavaScript workshop. Create a workspace at /home/ga/workshop/ with: (1) Progressive examples in files 01-callbacks-problem.js, 02-callbacks-fixed.js, 03-promises-basics.js, 04-async-await.js, 05-error-handling.js, 06-parallel-async.js showing evolution from callback hell to async/await with explanatory comments; (2) mock-api.js with Promise-returning functions using setTimeout for offline demos (e.g., fetchUser, fetchPosts, fetchComments); (3) .vscode/settings.json with large fonts (fontSize 16+), high contrast theme, and minimap disabled for projection; (4) .vscode/launch.json with Node.js debug config; (5) README.md with workshop objectives and instructions; (6) package.json with project metadata. All code must have teaching comments explaining concepts. This is for teaching 15 bootcamp students about async patterns.
